guards.freshPages: Every run fetches the published pages; --from-cache is an offline rerun only.
guards.confirmBeforeCommit: A changed motion replaces stored content only after two consecutive agreeing observations.
guards.sharedMotion: Identical study-specific motion text under two study IDs is the House serving one study page on another; both records hold their confirmed text.
guards.listing: A study absent from the current list is marked listed=false with lastListedAt unchanged and gains no revision.

observedPublisherDefects: The SRSR study pages served one another the same motion block during the November 24 refreshes; the run reports the pair under conflictingCalls and holds both.
The content warning block appears and disappears between page variants; it is stored as observed and never makes a revision.
note: No live study left the House consultation list during these runs, so droppedCalls is empty; the unit suite covers the marking path.
